# vibe-fix demo (mani-sample-vibe-fix)

> A small Vite + React notes app broken on purpose in five ways common to AI-built apps (Lovable, Bolt, Replit, Cursor, Claude Code), then diagnosed and fixed one commit at a time. Made by MANI as a public sample.

- Fixed app: https://mani-sample-vibe-fix.pages.dev
- Before (3 bugs still live): https://before.mani-sample-vibe-fix.pages.dev
- Source: https://github.com/runaway0508/mani-sample-vibe-fix
- Diagnosis report: https://github.com/runaway0508/mani-sample-vibe-fix/blob/main/docs/DIAGNOSIS.md

## The five problems
1. Build failure (TypeScript error)
2. Missing env var (no VITE_ prefix)
3. Auth redirect loop
4. Supabase RLS blocks reads
5. Routing 404 on Cloudflare Pages (stray 404.html)
